messages:
sam_johnson: Hey — signed up a few minutes ago, verified my email, added a card and 3DS passed but I didn't get the free trial credits. UI shows `Gated by payment review`. Account email sam@acme.com, acct id acct_ABC123. Any idea?

lina_support: Sorry about that — can you confirm the country on your account profile and the card issuer country (BIN)? Also did you use a VPN during signup?

sam_johnson: Card BIN looks like US (Visa ****4242) but my company billing address is Ireland. Didn't use a VPN. Email verification completed. 3DS flow succeeded, got the bank auth pop-up.

billing-bot: Flagged for manual review — reason: `BIN_COUNTRY_MISMATCH`. Policy note: cross-border BINs with differing account country trigger manual gate for additional verification.

lina_support: Thanks. That explains it — our automated gate held the trial credits pending manual review because the card BIN country doesn't match the account country. I'll escalate to ops-tier2 to speed the manual check. Can you DM the last 4 of the card and the signup IP?

ops-tier2: Received the escalation. We'll triage risk signals (3DS result, BIN check, signup IP history). ETA ~30–45m. If it's a low-risk case we'll manually apply the free-trial credits and add a note to avoid recurrence.

sam_johnson: DM sent with last4 4242 and signup IP 52.31.14.200. Thanks.

lina_support: :thumbsup: keeping this thread open — will update when ops confirms and credits applied. If ops approves now I'll annotate the account and apply the 10K trial credits immediately, then follow up with a brief root-cause (false positive on cross-border BIN).
